April 4, 2018 - By Lawrence Diaz 
Sterling Capital Management Llc increased its stake in Apple Inc Com (AAPL) by 10.41% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Sterling Capital Management Llc bought 23,329 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 247,424 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $41.87M, up from 224,095 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Sterling Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc Com for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $854.41 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.03% or $1.71   $168.39. About 30.28M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49%   uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500. 
Nomura Holdings Inc decreased its stake in Etrade Financial Corp (ETFC) by 58.46% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Nomura Holdings Inc sold 52,898 shares as the company’s stock rose 8.77% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 37,582 shares of the savings institutions company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.86 million, down from 90,480 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Nomura Holdings Inc who had been investing in Etrade Financial Corp for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $14.63 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.55% or $0.84   $55.17. About 3.23 million shares traded or 14.56% up from the average. E*TRADE Financial Corporation (NASDAQ:ETFC) has risen 61.16%   uptrending. It has outperformed by 49.61% the S&P500. 
Among 53 analysts covering Apple Inc. ( NASDAQ:AAPL ), 34 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 18 Hold. Therefore 64% are positive. Goldman Sachs maintained the stock with “Buy” rating in Monday, February 13 report. Loop Capital maintained Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) rating on Friday, November 3. Loop Capital has “Buy” rating and $200 target. Nomura maintained the shares of AAPL in report on Thursday, September 22 with “Buy” rating. The firm has “Buy” rating given on Friday, September 11 by Robert W. Baird. The rating was maintained by RBC Capital Markets on Monday, June 26 with “Buy”. The rating was maintained by Canaccord Genuity on Friday, February 2 with “Buy”. As per Friday, December 1, the company rating was downgraded by Gabelli. The company was maintained on Wednesday, March 28 by RBC Capital Markets. As per Thursday, August 20, the company rating was maintained by Bernstein.
